product_family: Zoho Projects — cloud-based project management platform with collaboration, task tracking, time logging, Gantt charts, and AI-powered features (Zia). Available in multiple editions (free, standard, professional, business). Includes mobile apps and third-party integrations.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 27001:2013
certifications.proof_quote: ISO/IEC 27001 — Valid: 21-Aug-2028. Widely recognized international security standard covering 'Applications, Systems, People, Technology, and Processes' across Zoho's cloud services

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type 2
certifications.proof_quote: SOC 2 Type 2 — Evaluates 'design and operating effectiveness of controls' meeting AICPA Trust Services Principles. Audit period: December-November annually; reports issued approximately three months post-completion. Security, Confidentiality, Processing Integrity, Availability, and Privacy.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 27701
certifications.proof_quote: ISO/IEC 27701 — Valid: 21-Aug-2028. Privacy management extension enabling organizations to 'establish, implement, maintain, and continually improve a Privacy Information Management System (PIMS)'

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 27017
certifications.proof_quote: ISO/IEC 27017 — Valid: 21-Aug-2028. Cloud-specific security controls providing 'implementation guidance for relevant controls' tailored to cloud service delivery

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 27018
certifications.proof_quote: ISO/IEC 27018 — Valid: 21-Aug-2028. Focuses on protecting personally identifiable information in public cloud environments, extending ISO/IEC 27001 and 27002 standards

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: Zoho implements GDPR controls as baseline standard globally. Features include Data Processing Addendum (DPA) based on Model Contractual Clauses, Data Protection Impact Assessments, breach notification within 72 hours, and choice of data centers (EU and other regions)

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: SOC 2 + HIPAA Type 2 — Third-party audit examining 'Security, Privacy and breach requirements' under HIPAA, with Zoho functioning as a Business Associate. Zoho Projects provides ePHI field marking, encryption, access control, and audit logging for healthcare compliance

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: PCI DSS — Valid: 14-Oct-2026. Payment Card Industry compliance (Self-Assessment: SAQ-D) ensuring secure handling of card data across financial products

certifications.name: ISO 9001
certifications.proof_quote: ISO 9001 — Valid: 02-Feb-2029. Quality Management System demonstrating ability to 'consistently provide quality products and services'

certifications.name: ISO 22301
certifications.proof_quote: ISO 22301 — Valid: 20-Nov-2026. Business Continuity Management System protecting operations from disruptions

certifications.name: Cyber Essentials Plus
certifications.proof_quote: Cyber Essentials Plus — Valid: 19-Sep-2026. UK government-backed certification with systems 'audited by approved assessors' for UK office and EU datacenters

certifications.name: TX-RAMP
certifications.proof_quote: TX-RAMP — Valid: 20-June-2027. Texas compliance certification at Level 1 (ServiceDesk Plus) and Level 2 (Endpoint Central, Site24x7)

certifications.name: ENS (Spain)
certifications.proof_quote: ENS (Spain) — Valid: 15-May-2027. Spanish National Security Scheme certification at intermediate category for cloud and on-premises solutions

certifications.name: CSA STAR
certifications.proof_quote: CSA STAR Self-Assessment — Cloud Security Alliance compliance documenting adherence to Cloud Controls Matrix across all Zoho cloud services

certifications.name: CCPA
certifications.proof_quote: CCPA — California privacy law compliance. Zoho's features enable users to 'comply with the CCPA' requirements and processing of Californian customer data adheres to CCPA requirements

certifications.name: SOC 1 Type 2
certifications.proof_quote: SOC 1 (SSAE 18/ISAE 3402 - Type 2) — 'Primarily concerned with examining controls relevant for financial reporting' across multiple Zoho products

privacy.ai_training_note: Zoho explicitly states: 'Zoho does not use customers' data to train the AI model or sell ads. As they have for more than 25 years, Zoho promises they will never monetize customers' data.' Customer content processed by Zia AI retains full customer ownership. No external vendor model exposure.
privacy.data_region: Multiple options including EU (via zoho.eu), US, and other regions. Choice of data center available at signup.

security.name: Encryption in Transit
security.value: SSL/TLS encryption for all data in motion

security.name: Encryption at Rest
security.value: Data encrypted at rest based on sensitivity level

security.name: Role-Based Access Control
security.value: Fine-grained role and permission management with field-level controls

security.name: Audit Logging
security.value: Comprehensive activity logging and audit trail for all database changes

security.name: Geographically Diverse Data Centers
security.value: Multiple geographically distributed data centers with replication for business continuity

security.name: Secure Development
security.value: Secure by design with vulnerability scanners and manual code reviews

security.name: Data Protection Impact Assessments
security.value: Conducts DPIAs as required by GDPR and other privacy regulations

products.name: Zoho Projects (Free)
products.data_scope: Basic project and task data; up to 3 users
products.notes: Community edition with no cost. All certifications apply.

products.name: Zoho Projects (Standard/Professional/Business)
products.data_scope: Full project collaboration, time tracking, resource management, custom fields with PII marking
products.notes: Paid tiers with increasing feature sets. Support for GDPR, HIPAA, CCPA. Optional encryption of custom fields marked as PII.

products.name: Zoho Projects + Zia AI
products.data_scope: Incorporates AI-powered features for task automation, insights, and recommendations
products.notes: Customer data NOT used to train Zia models. AI processing stays within Zoho infrastructure. No model training on customer data.

compare.pricing_model: Freemium subscription: Free, Standard ($45/month), Professional ($75/month), Business ($125/month). Per-user and per-project pricing options available.
compare.data_residency: Cloud-hosted SaaS only. Multiple geographic regions available including EU (via zoho.eu), US, India, and others. Customers can choose region at signup.
